# harmoniq_api_key (Resource)

A workspace API key, e.g. for CI. Issued by the provider's organization key (workspace keys can't issue keys). Changing anything issues a new key; destroying revokes it. The secret is only known when the key is created: `key` is empty after an import.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A deploy key for the checkout repository's CI, limited to its module.
resource "harmoniq_api_key" "checkout_ci" {
  workspace  = harmoniq_workspace.checkout_team.slug
  name       = "checkout-github-actions"
  scopes     = ["deploy:write"]
  module_ids = [harmoniq_remote_module.checkout.id]
}

output "checkout_ci_key" {
  value     = harmoniq_api_key.checkout_ci.key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, e.g. `github-actions`.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace slug.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Expiry as an RFC 3339 time, e.g. `2027-01-01T00:00:00Z`.
- `module_ids` (Set of String) Restrict the key to these modules (`harmoniq_remote_module.x.id`). All modules when unset.
- `scopes` (Set of String) `manifest:read`, `deploy:write` (default) or `admin`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Key id.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The secret (`hq_…`), known only at creation. Store it in your CI secrets.
- `prefix` (String) Displayed prefix of the key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The secret is not recoverable: `key` stays empty after an import.
terraform import harmoniq_api_key.checkout_ci checkout-team/<key-id>
```
